[[Image:Forrest Franklin.png|thumb|250px|Forrest Franklin]]
'''Forrest Franklin''' (Japanese: '''タクマ・ジロー''' ''Jirō Takuma'') is a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger|ranger}} who appeared as a [[character of the day]] in ''[[AG014|All in a Day's Wurmple]]''. [[Forrester Franklin]] is Forrest's identical twin brother; Forrest is distinguished by his blue t-shirt and a mole on the left side of his face.

Forrest lives in a forest just outside [[Rustboro City]], the place where he was born.  As a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger}}, he knows a lot about the area, such as where certain Pokémon appear. He dreams of traveling but is afraid to do so.

Forrest first appeared to help out {{an|May}} who was being attacked two-on-one by {{TRT}}. Initially introducing himself as Franklin, he helped May to find and {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} her [[May's Beautifly|Wurmple]]. Forrest admired May for her independence. Assuming that traveling helped May to become stronger, he decided to get over his fear and travel as well. At first, he suggested traveling with May and her friends but this did not happen and presumably he traveled by himself.

May took Forrest to meet {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}} and [[Max]] where he encountered his brother, who had just returned from his own journey. The twin brothers explained their uncanny similarity, which helped to clear up the initial confusion.

==Trivia==
* Both Forrest and his twin brother Forrester only own [[Generation II]] {{type|Bug}} Pokémon.
* Coincidentally, he has the same name as {{an|Brock}}'s [[Forrest|younger brother]] both in English and Japanese. In addition to this, they also have shared the same English voice actor at some point.
* Judging by his Japanese name, he is the younger of the two twins.
